Package com.csse3200.game.cards.play.integration

Class Team7PlayerStateAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.cards.play.integration.Team7PlayerStateAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlayerEffectConsumer, PlayerStateView
public final class Team7PlayerStateAdapter extends Object implements PlayerStateView, PlayerEffectConsumer
Adapts Team 7's player components to Team 5's read-only resolution view and result consumer.

Team 5 uses the read methods before resolving a card. The battle flow may call applyPlayerEffects(List) only after receiving a successful card-play result.
